_comment: Items of the four Stone Age stages (ADR 0059), loaded after items.json with the same schema. Extra keys: haft_x = durability multiplier a binding gives the tool it hafts (birch tar 2); knap_x = durability multiplier of the heads knapped from it (tempered flint 1.5), carried on the head and the tool as per-stack dur_x; speed = break-speed multiplier of a tool (the polished axe); launch = an item that throws another one from the inventory harder (the atlatl: {ammo, speed_x, damage_x}); shoots = a bow ({ammo, speed_x, damage_x, cooldown_s}); clothing = {slot: head|body|feet, warmth_c}: worn by right click, raises the temperature the body feels by up to warmth_c; paint = {color}: right click a wall paints a picture; boat = right click water launches it; ember_hours = a carried ember goes out after that many game hours; light = carried light (part C's torch_lights). stub = an item another part defines (ADR 0059 merge notes): skipped without an error when that part's definition is already loaded.

items.name: Birch Bark
items._note: peeled off a birch trunk with a knife (right click the bark)

items.name: Birch Tar
items._note: birch bark baked in a sealed earth oven: glues a head to its handle, the tool wears half as fast

items.name: Tempered Flint
items._note: flint baked under sand in an earth oven: knaps into heads that last half as long again

items.name: Smouldering Fungus
items._note: tinder fungus lit at a fire: carries the fire for half a day and lights four fires

items.name: Tinder Fungus
items._note: grows on birch: comes off with the bark now and then; right click a lit fire with it to carry an ember

items.name: Pyrite Striker
items._note: flint struck on pyrite: sparks that light fires (the Iron Age flint and steel is part D's)

items.name: Bone Needle
items._note: carved (knapped) from a bone with a stone: sews fur clothing

items.name: Bone Fish Hook
items._note: carved from a bone

items.name: Bone Harpoon Head
items._note: carved from a bone

items.name: Bone Harpoon
items._note: thrown at fish and game like a spear

items.name: Antler Pick
items._note: carved from an antler: the flint miner's pick, digs chalk and the deep flint in it

items.name: Fur Pelt
items._note: a raw hide left to dry without scraping keeps its fur

items.name: Fur Hood
items._note: sewn from a pelt with a bone needle; right click to put it on

items.name: Fur Cloak
items._note: three pelts sewn together

items.name: Fur Boots
items._note: two pelts sewn into boots

items.name: Spear-Thrower
items._note: atlatl: right click throws a spear from your inventory twice as far and harder

items.name: Animal Fat
items._note: pigs and bears; lamps and paint

items.name: Fat Lamp
items._note: a hollowed stone with fat and a grass wick: a light you carry into caves

items.name: Red Ochre Powder
items._note: red ochre ground on a stone

items.name: Yellow Ochre Powder
items._note: yellow ochre ground on a stone

items.name: Charcoal Powder
items._note: charcoal ground on a stone

items.name: Malachite Powder
items._note: a copper-bearing stone (malachite) ground on a stone

items.name: Red Paint
items._note: ochre and fat: right click a wall to paint

items.name: Microlith
items._note: a tiny flint bladelet: set in tar, the tip of an arrow

items.name: Arrow
items._note: shot from a bow; picked up again where it lands

items.name: Bow Stave
items._note: a split and shaved length of wood

items.name: Bow
items._note: right click shoots an arrow from your inventory

items.name: Flint Adze
items._note: hollows a burnt-out log into a dugout

items.name: Dugout Canoe
items._note: right click water to launch it, right click it to get in; W/S paddle, A/D turn, jump or sneak gets out

items.name: Drying Rack
items._note: hang meat or fish on it to dry; over a lit firepit it smokes them

items.name: Basket Trap
items._note: set it in water (right click the water); fish swim in over time

items.name: Fish Weir
items._note: a wattle fence across moving water: catches more than a basket trap

items.name: Fishing Line
items._note: a bone hook on cordage and a stick: right click water and wait for a bite

items.name: Fishing Net
items._note: right click water: a cast catches fish now and then

items.name: Axe Roughout
items._note: a knapped axe blank: grind it on sandstone with sand and water

items.name: Polished Stone Axe
items._note: slow to make, tough, and fells trees twice as fast

items.name: Einkorn Seeds
items._note: wild einkorn: tall grass drops it now and then

items.name: Emmer Seeds
items._note: wild emmer: tall grass drops it now and then

items.name: Flax Seeds
items._note: wild flax: tall grass and reeds drop it now and then

items.name: Flax
items._note: ret it in water, break it, spin it

items.name: Flour
items._note: grain ground on a stone with a hand stone (a saddle quern)

items.name: Flatbread Dough
items._note: flour wetted at the water: bake it on a firepit

items.name: Retted Flax
items._note: flax soaked in water until the fibers come loose

items.name: Warp-Weighted Loom
items._note: hang thread on it and weave cloth with right clicks

items.name: Linen Sack
items._note: a lighter bag woven from linen

items.name: Pot of Brine
items._note: a cooking pot filled at the sea: boil it dry on a firepit for salt

items.name: Lever Pole
items._note: pushes a megalith along its rollers, and raises it

items.name: Standing Stone
items._note: not an item you carry: the icon of megaliths and stone circles in the book and the travel picker

items.name: Wooden Wedge
items._note: driven into a crack to split stone loose

items.name: Copper Awl
items._note: native copper cold-hammered with a stone: sews like a bone needle and lasts longer

items.name: Copper Beads
items._note: native copper hammered into beads

items.name: Birch-Bark Box
items._note: the Iceman carried embers in one
